messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Neon Pairs is implemented. Open the self-contained [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html) directly to play offline.

The game includes board codes, snapshot import and export, saved preferences and best scores, and the replay CLI. The locked install, type check, six unit tests, and six browser tests passed. Browser verification included offline play, keyboard completion, accessibility-tree inspection, snapshot pausing, saved scores, and large-board focus.

No screen reader or real-device touch long press was used; those remain user acceptance checks. The tested versions and commands are recorded in the [README](/work/README.md).
